summary: Comprehensive backend + frontend testing of Sound Healing Greece MVP. Backend: 23/23 pytest tests PASSED covering auth (register/login/me), realms (7), academy (5 levels x 5 lessons + XP awards), stamps (10), practice CRUD, public receiver-feedback flow with +150 XP and stamp-first-practice award, community feed, and AI Oracle (Claude Sonnet 4.5 via emergentintegrations). Frontend: Mobile-viewport Playwright verified landing → register → Sanctuary (L1 user), admin login → Sanctuary (L4 user), all 5 tabs (Sanctuary/Journey/Academy/Practice/Profile) navigable, Profile shows Level Ring + stamps + name, Practice/new form opens with all expected fields. No critical issues found.

minor.issue: Email is lowercased on persist (correct behavior) but the user object returned to client is also lowercased — keep aware that callers must compare case-insensitively. No fix needed.
Has a redundant duplicate DB lookup on line 645 of server.py (await db.practices.find_one inside dict access). Works but inefficient. Low priority refactor.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning 'Unexpected text node: . A text node cannot be a child of a <View>' appears ~5 times after login on Sanctuary. Indicates whitespace/empty string is being rendered directly inside a <View> instead of inside <Text>. Functional but should be cleaned up. Search for stray '{ }' or template literals returning '' inside <View>.
Deprecation warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. Library-level, low priority.

action_items: Locate the stray text node inside a <View> on the Sanctuary tab (or shared Header/Card component) and wrap or remove it to eliminate the 'Unexpected text node' warnings.
(Optional) Refactor the duplicate DB lookup in GET /api/feedback/{token} (server.py:645).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~800 lines — fine for MVP but consider splitting into routers/auth.py, routers/practice.py, routers/academy.py for maintainability beyond MVP.
All routes correctly use Depends(get_current_user) for auth; public feedback endpoints correctly omit auth.
Mongo _id is excluded everywhere via projection or serialization — good.
JWT secret + Mongo URL + Emergent LLM key read from env — good. No hardcoded values.
EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL correctly used by frontend (verified via tests/conftest.py loading frontend/.env).

success_rate.frontend: 100% of tested flows (landing, register, login, 5-tab nav, profile, practice form)

seed_data_creation: Tests create TEST_user_<uuid>@example.com users and TEST_ practice sessions. Admin user is auto-seeded by backend on startup. Test data prefixed with TEST_/uitest_ for easy identification.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression tests in /app/backend/tests/test_api.py — run with: pytest /app/backend/tests/ -v --junitxml=/app/test_reports/pytest/pytest_results.xml. Frontend uses EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL (not EXPO_BACKEND_URL) — see conftest.py for env loading. Admin login: admin@soundhealing.gr / temple2026 (L4, all realms+stamps unlocked). Receiver feedback endpoint is intentionally public (no auth header).
rca_of_issue: N/A — no functional bugs detected. Only minor React Native console warnings worth cleaning up.
